description: Salesforce B2C Commerce APIs (SCAPI, OCAPI) and SDKs for building storefronts and merchant tools.
auth_notes: Admin APIs use an Account Manager API client; Shopper APIs use a SLAS client. Both yield OAuth 2.1-scope JWT access tokens sent as Bearer headers.
gate_detail: SCAPI is stated as no extra cost for B2C Commerce customers, so a B2C Commerce instance is implied. Developers create API or SLAS clients themselves; demo and on-demand sandboxes exist. MCP shopper service is a pilot needing an account executive.
api_scope: SCAPI Shopper and Admin REST APIs, legacy OCAPI, Node.js and React SDKs, and a Commerce Cloud CLI for B2C Commerce.
mcp_notes: Vendor-hosted B2C Commerce MCP Shopper Service, pilot only; requires SLAS onboarding and contacting the Salesforce account executive.
blocker_detail: Appears to require an existing B2C Commerce customer instance; sources do not state how a non-customer obtains one.
